ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a set of schematic diagrams of bird heads and bird beaks labeled with letters. The letter D is located in the upper-right middle position, and the bird head next to it has a short and thin, straight and pointed beak, with obvious dark facial markings around the eye; it is not like the flat broad beak of a duck, the hooked beak of a parrot or raptor, nor the long beak of a wading bird. Reasoning: The question asks what kind of bird D represents. Based on the thin pointed beak of the bird head at D and the facial stripe features similar to a small insectivorous songbird, it can be judged to be warbler.
